Nepal Floods Cause Widespread Devastation, Death Toll Rises

Flash floods in Nepal have resulted in at least 788 deaths, with over 2,500 people reported missing. The disaster has caused significant destruction, leading to the closure of the Kathmandu-Muglin road and impacting religious tourism. A UN climate chief highlighted the event as exposing the fragility of the Hindu Kush Himalayas, while also serving as a stark reminder for countries to improve disaster preparedness due to increasingly unpredictable and frequent natural events. Rescue operations have been affected by a breach of a lake dam on the China border.
